title: Show that deleting the rank-1 children still misses 1/99
body:
## Summary
- The selected local word has 2,412 rank-1 children. Deleting them moves that mass into the idle remainder, which rises from 1,646 to 4,058. The largest legal idle rank stays 51.
- At the planning target `a = 1/99`, the published relaxation of the deleted word still has its lower bound above one. The full word's relaxation is higher.
- The selected saving stays below the packing cap `169005411/100000000000`. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
